remarks.text: NW compartment pressure data from OM-4 suggests partial seal. 3-well programme mitigates.
OWC uncertainty ±12m. OM-7P planned 15m above OWC — sufficient standoff for P90 case.
Run OM-7P as pilot. If OWC confirmed within ±5m, proceed with OM-8P and OM-9I.
FDP update required before OM-9I spud (injection rates depend on fracture gradient).
Supersedes 2024 WPC decision. Lessons: slot sharing reduced rig time 15%.
